homonyms.reason: The source has no entries: it holds edges between a Hebrew node and an English node, and each route rests on one such edge. Before the retext each row carried the tag of its edge's sense (a part of speech, wn, and on most a topic area), which spoke of the sense and was no entry id; now the route text carries nothing but the word. Key חלק holds «part» among its routes, where before it held «part (n, wn, artifact)» and «part (n, wn, object)»; the route text cannot say whether two words on one key are senses of one word or two words. The source's own files give each edge its own id (its assertion address; each line of the store record names one line of that file) and the sense tag on both nodes; the route store dropped the id, and the retext took the tag off the text. 512 keys hold more than one route text (axis: keys), all of them different words, since no key holds one text twice (0).
